items.title_en: Essentials: Neuralink & Technologies to Enhance Human Brains | Dr. Matt MacDougall
items.title_cn: Essentials: Neuralink & Technologies to Enhance Human Brains | Dr. Matt MacDougall
items.desc_en: In this Huberman Lab Essentials episode, my guest is Dr. Matthew MacDougall, a neurosurgeon at Neuralink. We discuss how brain-machine interfaces could help people with paralysis control computers using their intended movements, and how robotic surgery enables the placement of tiny electrodes in the brain. We also explore advances in brain tumor surgery, implant safety, how the brain and software learn to work together, and the role of animal research. Dr. MacDougall shares his vision for future applications, including restoring movement, addressing mental health conditions and expanding human

items.title_en: How to Rewire Your Brain to Crave Healthy Foods
items.title_cn: How to Rewire Your Brain to Crave Healthy Foods
items.desc_en:
Dr. Scott Kanoski, PhD, is a Professor of Human and Evolutionary Biology and Neurobiology at the University of Southern California. 

We discuss how different foods impact memory and cognitive function as well as cravings. 

We also discuss how GLP-1 drugs work to control hunger in the brain and body, the role of the gut microbiome, and the effects of artificial and low calorie sweeteners on hunger and satiety. 

This episode highlights how nutrition impacts much brain health and learning capacity and how our memory impacts food choices too.   

*Follow Huberman Lab*
Instagram: https://www.ins

items.title_en: THANK YOU! To all of you who are reading or listening to PROTOCOLS
items.title_cn: THANK YOU! To all of you who are reading or listening to PROTOCOLS
items.desc_en:
https://www.hubermanlab.com/protocols-book

The response to the book has been overwhelming (in the positive sense of the word) and I’m delighted for that but the most gratifying thing for me is when I hear that people are learning about their physiology, and trying the protocols and realizing results that are helping them with sleep, mitigating, stress, learning and motivation, focus, using light to improve mitochondrial health across the brain and body, and on and on.

I’m also very grateful to @DrAndyGalpin, Alan Aragon, Samer Hattar Nick Norwitz who helped me shape the structure and content
